stem.text: A charged oil drop of mass $m$, with $n$ excess electrons, is held stationary in the uniform electric field between two horizontal plates separated by a distance $d$.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery labelled V connected across two horizontal parallel plates; an oil drop labelled m is between the plates, and the plate separation is labelled d.

stem.text: The voltage between the plates is $V$, the elementary charge is $e$ and the acceleration of free fall is $g$.
